'''Beta Company''' was a military unit that was part of the [[Cularin Militia]]. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Beta Company fought in the [[Thaereian system]]. The survivors later participated in a Militia parade on [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]].<ref name="Banner Days" />
